messages.body:
Sir
I installed Amber20 succesfully in centos 7 but as a root. i am not so
expert so i did this by searching installation process in some amber site
or linux installation site.
sir please guide me can i install it without going through root.
may be its difficult for beginners like me.
Is there any problem later installing as a root.
because i need to run tleap as a root.
Thanking you
Bibekananda Rabha
Research Scholar (DST-SERB)

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Mon, Sep 27, 2021, vivek rabha wrote:
> I installed Amber20 succesfully in centos 7 but as a root. i am not so
>expert so i did this by searching installation process in some amber site
>or linux installation site.
>sir please guide me can i install it without going through root.
>may be its difficult for beginners like me.
>Is there any problem later installing as a root.
>because i need to run tleap as a root.
You should not need to be root to install Amber, and we recommend against
doing so.
Detailed installation instructions are in Chapter 2 of the Reference Manual,
and CentOS details are here:
https://ambermd.org/InstCentOS.php
You don't say whether you ever tried to install as an ordinary user, and (if
so) what happened. Be sure that you are installing to a folder where you
have write permissions. But if you succeeded in installing as root, the
procedure is no different for non-root.
...good luck...dac
